_comment: No B-roll stinger splices: this is a 34.5s single take where every sentence carries information (who it's for, dates, time, both offices, what the session covers, the CTA) -- there is no connecting/filler span to cut away over. The four cuts between beats get brand wipes instead, no two neighbours the same style. Boundaries = cumulative keep-span durations from clips.json (8.63 / 8.66 / 7.64 / 5.07). The 'flash' sits on the beat change into 'So don't wait'.
